description:
The helper `is_test_or_spec_file` in `crystal_rules.ml` (lines 44-67) is 24 lines of hand-rolled substring matching that re-implements what Base's `String.contains` already does — and worse, contains a hand-rolled recursive `contains_substr` because the author didn't realize Base's version exists.

**Current code (paraphrased):**
```ocaml
let rec contains_substr str pat =
  let plen = String.length pat in
  let slen = String.length str in
  if plen > slen then false
  else if String.sub str 0 plen = pat then true
  else contains_substr (String.sub str 1 (slen - 1)) pat
  (* O(n*m) and allocates a new substring on every recursive call *)

let matched = List.exists (fun pat ->
  let plen = String.length pat in
  if String.length lower >= plen then
    let suffix = String.sub lower (String.length lower - plen) plen in
    pat = suffix
    || (pat = "test_" && String.length lower >= 5 && String.sub lower 0 5 = "test_")
    || contains_substr lower pat
  else false
) [ "/test/"; "/spec/"; ... ]
```

**Issues:**
1. `contains_substr` is O(n*m) and allocates 1 string per recursion (GC pressure on large files)
2. The `(pat = "test_" && ... String.sub lower 0 5 = "test_")` clause is dead — `contains_substr` already matches `"test_"` anywhere
3. Mixing prefix-only checks (suffix `String.sub`) with substring checks in one `List.exists` is confusing — should split into two passes
4. Pattern list mixes paths (`"/test/"`), file suffixes (`"_test.cr"`), and prefixes (`"test_"`) without grouping

**Proposed rewrite** (~15 lines, using Base):

```ocaml
let is_test_or_spec_file (file : string) : bool =
  let lower = String.lowercase_ascii file in
  let path_markers = ["/test/"; "/spec/"; "/benchmark/"; "/bench/"; "/example/"; "/examples/"; "/tests/"] in
  let file_suffixes = ["_test.cr"; "_spec.cr"; "_bench.cr"; "_tests.cr"] in
  let name_prefixes = ["test_"; "spec_"; "smell_"] in
  List.exists (String.is_substring ~needle:lower) path_markers
  || List.exists (fun suf -> String.is_suffix ~suffix:suf lower) file_suffixes
  || List.exists (fun p -> String.is_prefix ~prefix:p lower) name_prefixes
```

`Base.String` exports `is_substring`, `is_prefix`, `is_suffix` — all O(n) with no per-character allocation. Verify `open Base` is in scope (it is, line 7).

**Note:** The "smell_" entry is unusual — it matches files like `smell_*.cr` which are sample fixtures, not real test files. The comment says "smell sample test files" — this should probably move to a separate "sample fixture" detection so the production rule stays clean. Worth a follow-up discussion, not blocking this ticket.

Depends on: catseye-4o6 (split into submodules — helper lives in helpers file)
title: REFACTOR: simplify is_test_or_spec_file using Base String.contains
